data.narrative:
Nabla Bio is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Surge Biswas and Frances Anastassacos. The company has raised $37M plus $1.5B+ in partnership commitments. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the $37M total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $74M. This method captures the expected value expansion from current-stage to next-stage financing.

Peer-median benchmarking is not applicable; while 7 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier positioning—insufficient to support median pricing without introducing undue noise. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is also inapplicable, as target revenue is not disclosed (standard for private companies). The analysis thus supports a valuation range of $63M to $85M, centered on $74M. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of next-stage financing, the revenue trajectory implied by partnership value, and relative performance versus the identified private peer set.
